svg.text: Red dashed: TSS inbound (to Persian Gulf) · Blue dashed: TSS outbound (to Gulf of Oman).
Land traced from Natural Earth 10m (Public Domain) + Lesser Tonb from OpenStreetMap (ODbL);
islands minimally size-exaggerated for strategic readability - see README.
South shore (UAE coast / Arabia) added from the same Natural Earth source via a wider clip;
Qatar + far-west Abu Dhabi coast project west of the frame (x<0) and are cut off - see README.
